title: OATH LAP SHOWROOM
description: Vehicle previews now end with a ceremonial test lap where the driver swears loyalty to the car, the pit crew rings a tiny chrome bell, and the engine signs the decision in smoke.
consequence: The test drive gets knighted in public.

title: EARNED ARMOR PILGRIMAGE
description: Armor previews now show the shrine, boss wound, and miserable little staircase tied to each set, nudging players toward earning the look before buying a clean replica.
consequence: The cloak asks for a story before a cart.

title: CHOSEN ONE STARTER PACK
description: New characters can now buy a destiny bundle with prophecy robes, glowing ancestor approval, and a private cutscene where the ancient order guesses their name correctly enough.
consequence: The ancient prophecy finds the express lane.

title: STANDARDIZED FATE PREVIEW
description: Run-ending previews now flatten legendary deaths, cursed victories, and impossible combo endings into tidy badge categories before showing the unlock offer.
consequence: The apocalypse gets filed under completion rewards.
